name: cadview
description: Offline CAD and 3D model viewer for Android and iOS

scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.release:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.release:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.release:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
